name: io.github.autonomodotfun/autonomo
title: Autonomo
description: Let AI agents find x402 APIs and pay per call in USDG or $AUTONOMO on Robinhood Chain, or USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a new wallet just for your agent, with a small balance. Only needed for paid calls.

environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_PAY_WITH
environmentVariables.description: Token used when the agent doesn't say. auto pays with the first the wallet can afford: USDG, then $AUTONOMO, then USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_MAX_USDG_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Most one call may cost in USDG or USDC.

environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_MAX_AUTONOMO_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Most one call may cost in $AUTONOMO.

environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_DAILY_USDG
environmentVariables.description: Most dollars the server will spend per UTC day, in USDG and USDC on Base together.

environmentVariables.name: AUTONOMO_DAILY_AUTONOMO
environmentVariables.description: Most $AUTONOMO the server will spend per UTC day.
